[ISSUE]
**Title:** Incorrect Handling of Uppercase "Transfer-Encoding" in Chunked Requests

**Description:**
When sending a chunked-encoded HTTP request with the "Transfer-Encoding" header value in uppercase (e.g., "Chunked"), the server fails to properly parse the request body. This leads to unexpected empty responses instead of the intended data.

**Example:**
```
POST /echo HTTP/1.1
Transfer-Encoding: Chunked
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

4
foo=
3
bar
0
```

**Expected Behavior:**
The server should correctly recognize the "Transfer-Encoding: Chunked" header regardless of its case and parse the chunked body to produce the expected data:
```json
{
  "foo": ["bar"]
}
```

**Actual Behavior:**
The server returns an empty response (`{}`) instead of the expected parsed data, indicating that the uppercase "Chunked" value was not properly handled.
[/ISSUE]
